content.text: In regions where platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-12|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are inaccessible, the need for a robust, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-12|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce solution is vital. Whether you're in Nigeria, Kenya, or Venezuela, conventional payment processors often leave creators high and dry. This guide will walk you through building a crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-11|cloudflare]] Pages, ensuring you maintain full control over your digital products and revenue streams.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms impose restrictions that hinder the growth of digital creators in many regions. COREMERCH's infrastructure is built for sovereignty, allowing you to own your stack without reliance on third-party services. With Cloudflare Pages, you gain a reliable hosting solution, while NOWPayments facilitates seamless crypto transactions. This combination empowers you to operate independently, ensuring your business thrives even in challenging financial landscapes.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment, gather essential tools: a GitHub account for version control, a Cloudflare account for hosting, and a NOWPayments account for payment processing. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic and Supabase for storing order data. These components are crucial for a successful build, allowing you to create a fully functional digital store that accepts cryptocurrencies without the need for conventional payment methods.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend using Cloudflare Workers, which handles your store's logic efficiently. Integrate NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Set up automated webhooks to trigger order confirmations upon payment. Finally, ensure your digital products are stored securely in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ready for instant delivery once a transaction is completed. This pipeline guarantees a seamless customer experience.
Own your entire infrastructure without relying on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your infrastructure, it's time to go live. Publish your site on Cloudflare Pages and conduct thorough testing to ensure everything functions as expected. Process your first transaction by purchasing one of your digital products. Monitor the payment confirmation through NOWPayments to verify that your setup works flawlessly. This step is crucial for building confidence in your system and providing a reliable service to your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Streamline your payment processing with over 300 cryptocurrencies and low fees.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, use Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to operate without traditional payment platforms, ensuring full control over your transactions.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, allowing deployment in 4-6 hours. Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, with deployment taking up to 48 hours, providing a more robust infrastructure for handling larger volumes.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms offer reliable hosting solutions, allowing you to manage your store efficiently while maintaining control over your digital assets.
What payment options are available through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing customers to pay in their preferred digital currency. With low transaction fees and no KYC requirements, it offers a flexible payment solution ideal for creators.
How can I scale my digital store effectively?

To scale your digital store, focus on adding more products and optimizing your payment processes. Utilize resources like The Sovereign Blueprint to explore advanced strategies and ensure your infrastructure can handle increased traffic.
